opening.argument: The video is a Hindi tutorial that explains how to register for an Amazon Associate account, share product links, and receive commissions when viewers make purchases. It directs viewers to “go into amazon associate account” and “go to registration,” then explains that if viewers buy through a shared link, the presenter will receive profit. It also describes reaching an audience through websites and social platforms, while displaying an earnings chart and a reported 75,000 over the last 30 days. Those earnings figures are promotional claims within the tutorial, but the material does not establish guaranteed returns, deceptive registration, upfront fees, or requests for private credentials. The like, share, and subscribe prompt is ordinary audience engagement and is not tied to receiving earnings or joining the program.
